name: DMB-X
description: The Dual Mesh Benchmark multi-engine extension (DMB-X): eight engine columns measured on the frozen B1 corpus, extending DMB v1.0 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23303081), v2.0 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23321637), and the DeepSeek v4-pro column (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23345241). PROTOCOL (preregistered before execution, commit b293d58): frozen corpus CORPUS_B1.json (sha256 13295d197be59dd1266814bc2f961f1e55e974c61c642fd9c7a6a389668fee59), first-20-in-file-order selection rule, byte-identical prompt contract to the DeepSeek B1 leg, one representative engine per family via OpenRouter raw API, fresh stateless request per instance, wall-clock request-to-full-response, raw responses preserved verbatim per instance. All five falsifiers held: raw logs preserved, frozen corpus/selection verified at run time, no distribution-improving retries, no post-hoc metrics, no silent engine substitutions.
